{{Top|leg}}
'''Operation Echo Quake''' was a two-part military operation carried out by the [[Imperial Navy (Sith Empire)|Imperial Navy]] during the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]]. The [[Empire's Fury]] squadron and the Imperial Navy [[Attack on the Hutt Cartel listening post|destroyed]] a [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Republic]] listening station in [[Hutt Space/Legends|Hutt Space]] and [[Battle above Saleucami|wiped out]] the Republic's [[Solar Thrantas]] squadron at [[Saleucami/Legends|Saleucami]].
